content: No, this is not true. The so-called "13th AHV pension" is not a separate benefit that one must apply for; it is simply the regular monthly old-age or invalidity pension payment after the 12th payment has been made. In Switzerland, Old Age and Survivors' Insurance (AHV) pays pensions on a monthly basis. By the time the 13th payment is received, it is just the next regular installment in the annual cycle of monthly payments. There is no special eligibility requirement or separate application process for receiving the "13th" pension. It is automatically part of the standard pension scheme for all eligible beneficiaries.
